report.answer: After an export that left out cuts, the editor now shows a warning toast ("Export incomplete") listing the missing cut numbers, in English and Korean. I did not run the app or test the toast in a browser. I also added `X-Missing-Cuts` to the backend's exposed CORS headers in `main.py`. Without that the browser can't read the header from a cross-origin request.

@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+"""Safe loading of images referenced by user-settable strings.
+
+The backend never makes an HTTP request for such a reference. It accepts
+only data: URLs and objects in our own storage (a relative key, or a URL
+under STORAGE_HOST, which is turned into a storage key). Anything else is
+refused.
+"""
+import base64
+from typing import Optional
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+
+
+def storage_key(ref: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return the storage object key for a reference, or None if it is not
+    one of our storage objects."""
+    ref = (ref or "").strip()
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    if host and ref.startswith(host + "/"):
+        key = ref[len(host) + 1:]
+    elif "://" in ref or ref.startswith(("//", "\\")) or ":" in ref.split("/", 1)[0]:
+        return None
+    else:
+        key = ref
+    key = key.split("?", 1)[0].split("#", 1)[0]
+    if not key or key.startswith("/") or "\\" in key or any(p in ("..", ".") for p in key.split("/")):
+        return None
+    return key
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Image bytes for a data: URL or a storage object; None otherwise."""
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    if ref.startswith("data:image"):
+        try:
+            return base64.b64decode(ref.split(",", 1)[1])
+        except Exception:
+            return None
+    key = storage_key(ref)
+    if key is None:
+        return None
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    return storage.download_image(key)

+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+
+from tests import lab_env
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+INTERNAL = [
+    "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
+    "http://127.0.0.1:8000/secret.png",
+    "http://10.0.0.5/admin",
+    "https://internal.example/x.png",
+    "//10.0.0.5/x.png",
+    "http://minio.invalid:9000/bucket/../../admin",
+    "http://minio.invalid:9000.evil.test/x.png",
+    "file:///etc/passwd",
+]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def no_http(monkeypatch):
+    import requests
+
+    def boom(*a, **kw):
+        raise AssertionError("backend made an HTTP request")
+
+    for name in ("get", "post", "request"):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(requests, name, boom)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "request", boom)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ref", INTERNAL)
+def test_loader_refuses_foreign_urls(no_http, ref):
+    from app.services.image_source import load_image_bytes
+
+    assert load_image_bytes(ref) is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ref", INTERNAL)
+def test_ai_and_board_downloaders_refuse_foreign_urls(no_http, ref):
+    from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+    from app.services.reference_board import download_image
+
+    assert BaseAIService._download_image(object.__new__(BaseAIService), ref) is None
+    assert download_image(ref) is None
+
+
+def test_loader_keeps_storage_and_data_urls(no_http):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+    from app.services.image_source import load_image_bytes
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    key = storage.upload_image(lab_env.PNG, "proj", "abc")
+    assert load_image_bytes(key) == lab_env.PNG
+    assert load_image_bytes(f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{key}") == lab_env.PNG
+    data = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(lab_env.PNG).decode()
+    assert load_image_bytes(data) == lab_env.PNG
+
+
+def test_zip_export_never_fetches_user_set_urls(client, no_http):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+    eid = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"project_id": pid, "title": "Ep", "episode_order": 1}).json()["id"]
+    key = storage.upload_image(lab_env.PNG, "proj", "abc")
+    paths = ["http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/", f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{key}"]
+    cut_ids = []
+    for i, _ in enumerate(paths):
+        r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": eid, "cut_order": i + 1})
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+        cut_ids.append(r.json()["id"])
+    for cid, path in zip(cut_ids, paths):
+        r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cid}", headers=h, json={"image_path": path})
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    names = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)).namelist()
+    assert sorted(names) == ["Ep_02.png", "missing.txt"]
+
+
+def _episode_with_cuts(client, h, paths):
+    pid = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+    eid = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"project_id": pid, "title": "Ep", "episode_order": 1}).json()["id"]
+    for i, path in enumerate(paths):
+        cid = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": eid, "cut_order": i + 1}).json()["id"]
+        if path:
+            assert client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cid}", headers=h, json={"image_path": path}).status_code == 200
+    return eid
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+def test_export_reports_missing_cuts(client, no_http, fmt):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    key = storage.upload_image(lab_env.PNG, "proj", "abc")
+    good = f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{key}"
+    eid = _episode_with_cuts(client, h, [good, None, "http://10.0.0.5/x.png", good, "proj/abc/nope.png"])
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,5"
+    if fmt == "zip":
+        z = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content))
+        assert z.read("missing.txt").decode().split("\n") == ["2", "3", "5", ""]
+        assert sorted(n for n in z.namelist() if n != "missing.txt") == ["Ep_01.png", "Ep_04.png"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+def test_export_with_nothing_missing_has_no_report(client, no_http, fmt):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    key = storage.upload_image(lab_env.PNG, "proj", "abc")
+    eid = _episode_with_cuts(client, h, [key, key])
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+    if fmt == "zip":
+        assert "missing.txt" not in zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)).namelist()
